faq.question: What is the Lovart AI Bakery Menu Maker?
faq.answer: The Lovart AI Bakery Menu Maker is part of Lovart, the World's First AI Design Agent. It uses MCoT (Multi-step Chain of Thought) as your Creative Director to design professional bakery menus — from croissant displays to cake catalogs — all through natural language conversations on ChatCanvas.

faq.question: Is Lovart free to use for bakery menu design?
faq.answer: Yes! Lovart offers free daily credits so you can try AI bakery menu design at no cost. Create and download menus to test the full experience before upgrading to a paid plan.

faq.question: What are Lovart's pricing plans for professional use?
faq.answer: Lovart offers three monthly plans: Starter at 2,000 credits/month, Basic at 3,500 credits/month, and Pro at 11,000 credits/month. Paid plans include full commercial rights for your bakery menu designs.

faq.question: Do I get commercial rights for my bakery menus?
faq.answer: Yes, all paid Lovart plans (Starter, Basic, and Pro) include full commercial usage rights. This means you own the menus you create and can use them for your business, print them, and distribute them without restrictions.

faq.question: What file formats can I export my bakery menu in?
faq.answer: Lovart supports 8K resolution export in PNG, JPG, SVG, and PSD formats. PNG and JPG are perfect for social media and digital displays, SVG for scalable web use, and PSD for advanced editing and professional printing.

faq.question: How does Touch Edit work for bakery menus?
faq.answer: Touch Edit lets you click any element on your menu directly on ChatCanvas — a price tag, a pastry photo, a section header — and modify it instantly. You can update prices, swap food images, resize elements, and adjust layouts with precise, intuitive controls.

faq.question: How does Text Edit work for updating menu items?
faq.answer: Text Edit allows you to change any text on your bakery menu with a simple click and type. Update item names, prices, descriptions, or add daily specials. Changes are reflected instantly on ChatCanvas, and you can edit multiple items in rapid succession.

faq.question: Can Lovart help me design different types of bakery menus?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Lovart's MCoT agent adapts to any bakery menu type — pastry displays, artisan bread menus, cake catalogs, cafe drink menus, seasonal specials, and more. Just describe what you need, and the AI Creative Director will design accordingly.

faq.question: Does Lovart maintain brand consistency across all my menus?
faq.answer: Yes. Once Lovart understands your bakery's brand identity — colors, fonts, logo, and visual style — it applies consistent branding to every menu you create. This ensures your pastry menu, drink menu, and cake catalog all feel like one cohesive bakery brand.
